## Outcome

Describe the user-visible or architectural result.

## Estimation and contract impact

- [ ] Estimation semantics are unchanged, or the relevant root decisions are updated.
- [ ] Serialized contracts and schemas are unchanged, or compatibility is documented and tested.
- [ ] New dependencies, fixtures, datasets, models, and assets have recorded provenance and licenses.
- [ ] No client source, credentials, private calibration data, or machine-specific personal data is included.

## Verification

List the focused tests and release gates run. Behavioral changes require tests;
ordinary unit fixtures must remain storage-independent.
